metadata.title: National Citizen Documents Catalog for Welfare & Schemes
metadata.description: Comprehensive authority, validity, and verification guide for government scheme documents.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card (UIDAI)
documents.issuing_authority: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Ministry of Electronics & IT
documents.validity: Lifetime (Requires periodic biometric update at ages 5 & 15)
documents.usage_frequency: Required by >61% of all Indian Government schemes
documents.verification_method: UIDAI OTP Authentication / Biometric / e-KYC XML / QR code verification
key_fields: Date of Birth / Year of Birth
documents.npci_seeding_requirement: Crucial for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Bank account must be seeded with NPCI Aadhaar payment bridge.

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.issuing_authority: Revenue Department (Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate / District Magistrate)
documents.usage_frequency: Required for all means-tested schemes (scholarships, housing, pensions, subsidies)
documents.verification_method: State e-District portal certificate number verification / QR code scan

documents.name: Caste / Community Certificate (SC / ST / OBC / EWS)
documents.validity: SC/ST: Lifetime; OBC-NCL (Non-Creamy Layer): 1 Financial Year; EWS: 1 Financial Year
documents.usage_frequency: Required for affirmative action welfare schemes, affirmative scholarships, fee concessions
documents.verification_method: e-District verification portal / Caste certificate tracking system

documents.name: Domicile / Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC)
documents.validity: Lifetime (unless specified otherwise by State Gazette)
documents.usage_frequency: Required for State-sponsored welfare schemes (over 1,500 State/UT schemes)
documents.verification_method: State e-District portal barcode / certificate lookup
key_fields: Years of Continuous Residence in State

documents.name: Bank Account Passbook / Statement (DBT-Enabled)
documents.issuing_authority: Scheduled Commercial Banks / Regional Rural Banks / India Post Payments Bank (IPPB)
documents.validity: Active account (Must not be dormant / inoperative)
documents.usage_frequency: Mandatory for 100% of cash DBT subsidy & pension schemes
documents.verification_method: Public Financial Management System (PFMS) penny drop / Account validation API
key_fields: Account Holder Name (must match Aadhaar spelling)

documents.name: Land Records / Record of Rights (RoR / Khasra / Khatauni / Jamabandi)
documents.issuing_authority: Department of Land Resources / Revenue Department
documents.validity: Current revenue year / Latest mutation entry
documents.usage_frequency: Mandatory for PM-KISAN, PMFBY (Crop Insurance), Kisan Credit Card (KCC), Agri-subsidies
documents.verification_method: Bhoomi / Bhulekh / Banglarbhumi / MeeBhoomi / AnyRoR state land record APIs

documents.name: Ration Card (NFSA / BPL / AAY)
documents.issuing_authority: Department of Food & Public Distribution / State Food & Civil Supplies
documents.validity: Valid as long as family fulfills NFSA quota / verified annually
documents.usage_frequency: Required for PMAY Housing, Ayushman Bharat eligibility (SECC), Free Foodgrain (PMGKAY), State food subsidies
documents.verification_method: Annavitran Portal / State NFSA PDS Portal API / RCMS lookup
key_fields: Card Type (AAY - Antyodaya, PHH - Priority Household, Non-NFSA)
Family Members List with Aadhaar UID

documents.name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) / Disability Certificate
documents.issuing_authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice & District Medical Board
documents.validity: Permanent (for non-progressive disabilities) or Temporary (with specified re-assessment date)
documents.usage_frequency: Required for Divyangjan pensions, assistive aids (ADIP), reserved scholarships, travel concessions
key_fields: Disability Type (Locomotor, Visual, Hearing, Intellectual, etc.)
Percentage of Disability (Minimum 40% required for government benefits)

documents.name: Educational Marksheets & Certificates (10th, 12th, Degree, Bonafide)
documents.issuing_authority: State School Boards / CBSE / ICSE / Recognized Universities / DigiLocker
documents.usage_frequency: Required for all student scholarships (National Scholarship Portal, Post-Matric, State Merit Schemes)
documents.verification_method: DigiLocker NAD (National Academic Depository) / Roll Number verification API
